svg.title: dsh-export-ctl-check: two inputs, eight gates, two exits, one report
svg.desc: A register (JSON or YAML: four optional header scalars, rows[] with 13 canonical column aliases) and the versioned rule pack enter from the left. Eight gates are stacked in one ladder. The first three form the only conditional chain: EC-001 presence on controlled, EC-002 conditionalPresence asking for licenseNo when controlled holds one of the configured values, EC-003 conditionalPresence asking for licenseAt when licenseNo is filled. The other five are independent: EC-004 presenceAny over endUse and endUser, EC-005 presence on destination, EC-006 uniqueness of licenseNo, EC-007 enum over the institution's category values, EC-008 containsAny placeholder terms in itemName. Each gate leaves through exactly one exit: issues[] for what it found, skipped[] for what it could not run, with the reason. In the quickstart run one gate hits (EC-001: controlled empty on row 1, warn), two are skipped (EC-002: no row satisfies the controlled condition; EC-007: values ship empty) and five pass. Both exits converge on one report, error 0 / warn 1 / info 0, issueCount 1, skippedCount 2, rulesetVersion 2026.1, rendered as markdown plus reportJson. Read-only, offline, no model call, no control list held.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 条件链 controlled → licenseNo → licenseAt + 五条独立规则；命中的进 issues[]，跑不了的进 skipped[]。
